title: Extract a duplicated block into a helper
prompt: src/report.ts formats money in two places with the same code. Extract a helper `formatMoney(cents: number): string` in the same file and use it in both places. Behaviour must not change.
check: bun test && grep -c "function formatMoney" src/report.ts | grep -qx 1 && [ "$(grep -c "toFixed(2)" src/report.ts)" = 1 ]
